data.acquisitionSummary: Current Globe prepaid terms still contain a one-year regular-load rule for ordinary registered prepaid lines, but foreign nationals registered as tourists are a separate case: their SIM/eSIM automatically expires 30 days after registration. The old cheap yearly-keep framing therefore does not apply to the target foreign-tourist route.

keep.action: Foreign-tourist registration is the binding rule for this use case: Globe states the tourist SIM/eSIM automatically expires 30 days after registration. The ordinary one-year regular-load rule is not an annual keep path for a tourist-registered line.

data.chinaActivation: Foreign tourists must register the SIM with passport bio page, current visa stamp, proof of Philippine address and a return/onward ticket. Tourist registration is short-lived rather than a China-first long-term retention route.
data.kyc: SIM registration is mandatory. Globe states foreign tourists need passport, current visa stamp, Philippine address proof and return/onward ticket; tourist SIM registration expires after 30 days.
data.payment: GlobeOne and GCash support reloads while abroad, but payment convenience does not override the 30-day tourist-registration lifetime.
data.wifiCalling: Not relied on for this route decision.
data.roamingSms: Official Globe prepaid roaming support says a prepaid line can keep roaming signal with zero load and can receive incoming texts for free while abroad.
data.refund: Globe terms state load on a permanently disconnected SIM is not refundable for cash.
data.holdReason: Foreign-tourist SIM/eSIM registration automatically expires after 30 days, so the legacy one-top-up-per-year framing is not valid for the target overseas foreign-user retention job.
data.tariffSummary: Tourist registration: 30-day automatic expiry. Ordinary prepaid one-year load rule exists but is not a tourist keep-number path.
guideSteps: HOLD for foreign-tourist long-term retention: registration expires after 30 days.
Do not model the ordinary one-year load rule as a tourist annual keep cost.
